visual_review: Delivery person in a cap at the left holding a parcel out in front, the parcel's lid swung open, following the reference's arrangement; the current drawing had a floating cap/head, a Z-shaped body and an unattached box with a slash, so no person or open box read.
omissions: The body is a stick figure (head, torso, legs, one forward arm) rather than the reference's outlined torso and two arms; the lid is a single slanted flap.
